scope: Exact-URL Internet Archive inquiry for selected Apple and JPMorgan 2025 Q3 scale documents; this is not an exhaustive archive search.

apple.interpretation: No exact-URL capture returned by these two routes for the queried scope; this is not evidence that no archived or public copy exists.

first_replay.interpretation: Returned body is an incomplete PDF response: its SHA-1 base32 matches CDX, but it is an exact 5 MiB prefix of the later complete body and lacks the PDF EOF trailer. CDX length-field and replay content-length semantics are unresolved.

later_replay.interpretation: Complete archived replay: its SHA-1 base32 matches CDX, its SHA-256 and byte count exactly match the retained corpus PDF, and it parses as 358 pages. The CDX length field differs from replay bytes and is not used as a byte-count acceptance condition. Archive timestamp/source remain conditional on provenance assumptions.

admission_decision.reason: This inquiry supplies one exact-version archive lead but does not define a study cutoff, admission policy, or independent archive timestamp authentication; no panel-wide eligibility is inferred.
